postings.title: Senior Software Engineer
postings.description:
Why Engineering @loveholidays?

At loveholidays - we trailblaze together. We’re on a mission to open the world to everyone, giving our customers’ unlimited choice, unmatched ease and unmissable value for their next getaway. Our team is the driving force behind our role as our customers’ personal holiday expert - the smart way to get away.

Technology at loveholidays underpins our vision to become the most loved OTA in Europe. We drive cutting-edge innovation and technical excellence to futureproof the business. Our systems process trillions of daily holiday offers, we deploy over a thousand times a month, serving thousands of requests per second. This is where you can accelerate your growth by solving complex challenges and broadening your skillset.

Join us to create impact for our future in an exciting new chapter, owning your success and contributing to shared goals. We actively talk about technology https://tech.loveholidays.com/ and adhere to our key technology principles https://tech.loveholidays.com/the-5-principles-that-helped-scale-loveholidays-7ea0b0fd3df9 that have guided us this far. We are growing and have ambitious plans to expand across Europe, employing the best minds and technology to let us do this.


The impact you’ll have:

Senior Software Engineers at loveholidays have strong expertise in:

 - Supplier integration systems that process vast amounts of data

 - Industry leading bespoke, high performance search and recommendation systems

 - Sophisticated real time pricing systems

 - Complex domain modelling and implementation of booking payment, fulfilment and management systems

 - AI-powered solutions to assist customers pre and post booking

 - Best in class, modern user experience through web and mobile applications

For a better understanding of our work, refer to some of our blog posts https://tech.loveholidays.com/.

Or our open source contributions:

 - github.com/loveholidays/ripley http://github.com/loveholidays/ripley

 - github.com/loveholidays/eval-kit https://github.com/loveholidays/eval-kit

 - github.com/loveholidays/po-test http://github.com/loveholidays/po-test

As part of our tech culture we continuously improve our time to delivery, reducing errors and generally leaving things better than you found them.



Your day-to-day:

 - Adoption of our engineering principles https://tech.loveholidays.com/the-5-principles-that-helped-scale-loveholidays-7ea0b0fd3df9

 - Building and running services at scale in the cloud

 - Collaborating with engineers, designers, product managers within and outside of the team

 - Implementing maintainable and well-tested solutions iteratively, keeping business impact and observability as a primary focus

 - Understanding the wider context of the business and designing system architectures that meet short and long term business goals



Your skillset:

 - Algorithms, data structures

 - Observability

 - Web services, REST, HTTP

 - Containers, cloud

 - Testing, reliability, monitoring

 - Strong knowledge in building and owning application end-to-end, from inception to maintenance, to retirement

 - Designing systems that scale

 - Expertise in some of our main programming languages - TypeScript, Java, Golang, Rust, Python
   
   

Desirable

 - Experience with Kubernetes, Prometheus, Terraform, NoSQL or GCP
   
   

Perks of joining us:

 - Company pension contributions at 5%

 - Individualised training budget for you to learn on the job and level yourself up

 - Discounted holidays for you, your family and friends

 - 25 days of holidays per annum (plus 8 public holidays) increases by 1 day for every second year of service, up to a maximum 30 days per annum

 - Ability to buy and sell annual leave

 - Cycle to work scheme, season ticket loan and eye care vouchers



The interview journey:

 - TA screening - 30 mins

 - 1st Stage - Introduction - 45 mins

 - Coding challenge - take home test or live pairing

 - 2nd Stage - 3 hours

At loveholidays, we focus on developing an inclusive culture and environment that encourages personal growth and collective success. Each individual offers unique perspectives and ideas that increase the diversity and effectiveness of our teams. And we value the insight and potential you could bring on our continued journey.

postings.title: Principal Software Engineer
postings.description:
Why Technology at loveholidays?

At loveholidays - we trailblaze together. We’re on a mission to open the world to everyone, giving our customers’ unlimited choice, unmatched ease and unmissable value for their next getaway. Our team is the driving force behind our role as our customers’ personal holiday expert - the smart way to get away.

Technology at loveholidays underpins our vision to become the most loved OTA in Europe. We drive cutting-edge innovation and technical excellence to futureproof the business. Our systems process trillions of daily holiday offers, we deploy over a thousand times a month, serving thousands of requests per second. Join us to create impact for our future in an exciting new chapter, owning your success and contributing to shared goals. We are growing and have ambitious plans to expand across Europe, employing the best minds and technology to let us do this.



The impact you'll have:

As a Principal Engineer in the Boost team, you'll be part of a group of principal engineers who champion technical excellence. The team acts as an enabling function, not a delivery arm. You will embed in other teams to help them improve and work faster. You will be hands-on, leading by example, and coaching others to drive technical excellence and innovation across the company. Your success will be measured by how you help others succeed.

Your responsibilities include:

 - Own the team's functional KPIs, defining the measurable outcomes that show our impact.

 - Help mission teams deliver faster, safer solutions by solving complex problems and training others to do the same.

 - Champion AI adoption, applying it to both engineering processes and solutions.

 - Coach our engineers, guiding their growth.

 - Build tools to make the Boost team more effective and improve platform governance.

We are looking for a candidate with strong front-end skills. You will work across the various tech systems within our platform and be confident in your ability to quickly learn new technologies. We value an agile mindset, and a proven track record of delivery with teams.

For a better understanding of our work, refer to some of our blog posts:

 - How loveholidays is solving the technical excellence paradox https://tech.loveholidays.com/how-loveholidays-is-solving-the-technical-excellence-paradox-933987956758

 - Your AI Hates Your Prompts (And So Do You) https://tech.loveholidays.com/your-ai-hates-your-prompts-and-so-do-you-c05f59337b13

 - Stop Chasing Ghost Errors: A Systematic Approach to Frontend Error Monitoring That Actually Works https://tech.loveholidays.com/stop-chasing-ghost-errors-a-systematic-approach-to-frontend-error-monitoring-that-actually-works-fe5e1c8790cc

 - Does website speed contribute to customers booking holidays online? https://tech.loveholidays.com/does-website-speed-contribute-to-customers-booking-holidays-online-f17bd696bc30

 - Creating a Zero Surprises Culture https://tech.loveholidays.com/from-firefighting-to-foresight-a-new-culture-of-software-reliability-affcf565f9b3

Or our open source contributions:

 - github.com/loveholidays/ripley http://github.com/loveholidays/ripley

 - github.com/loveholidays/eval-kit https://github.com/loveholidays/eval-kit

 - github.com/loveholidays/po-test http://github.com/loveholidays/po-test

 - github.com/loveholidays/mcp-html-share http://github.com/loveholidays/mcp-html-share

As part of our tech culture, we continuously improve our time to deliver, reduce errors, and generally leave things better than we found them.




Your day to day:

You will:

 - Embed in mission teams to solve hard tech problems, coaching engineers hands-on to instill our core engineering principles https://tech.loveholidays.com/the-5-principles-that-helped-scale-loveholidays-7ea0b0fd3df9.

 - Drive initiatives to apply AI to build better solutions and improve our engineering process.

 - Build tooling and processes to accelerate and enable our platform development.

 - Design and oversee impactful systems that run reliably at cloud scale.

 - Write and speak about our tech work to raise our engineering profile.



Your skillset:

 - Experience with AI-powered feature development and leveraging AI tooling for software delivery, with enthusiasm for transforming how we build and deliver software.

 - Demonstrable history of working hands-on with engineering teams to solve complex technical challenges, building team capabilities and promoting sustainable practices.

 - Seasoned facilitator who excels at pairing with engineers, leading technical discussions, and helping teams navigate architectural decisions through practical, hands-on collaboration.

 - Ability to identify and scale successful technical patterns while connecting technical excellence to measurable business outcomes.

 - A track record of building and optimising scalable, high-performance websites.



Perks of joining us:

 - Company pension contributions at 5%.

 - Individualised training budget for you to learn on the job and level yourself up.

 - Discounted holidays for you, your family and friends.

 - 25 days of holidays per annum (plus 8 public holidays) increases by 1 day for every second year of service, up to a maximum 30 days per annum.

 - Ability to buy and sell annual leave.

 - Cycle to work scheme, season ticket loan and eye care vouchers.



At loveholidays, we focus on developing an inclusive culture and environment that encourages personal growth and collective success. Each individual offers unique perspectives and ideas that increase the diversity and effectiveness of our teams. And we value the insight and potential you could bring on our continued journey.



The interview journey:

 1. 1st stage interview with a member of our Talent Team 

 2. Introduction to loveholidays Engineering with our VP of Engineering (60 mins)

 3. Presentation/Case Study with our VP and CTO (60 mins)

 4. Technical interview with 2 of our Principal or Heads of Engineering (60 mins)

You’ll create impact for our future by taking ownership, contributing to shared goals and helping shape what  comes next, all as part of our enhanced international community of talented, collaborative and passionate teams.



Why Technology at loveholidays?

Technology at loveholidays underpins our vision to become the most loved OTA in Europe. We drive cutting-edge innovation and technical excellence to futureproof the business. Our systems process trillions of daily holiday offers, we deploy over a thousand times a month, serving thousands of requests per second. This is where you can accelerate your growth by solving complex challenges and broadening your skillset.


Join us to create impact for our future in an exciting new chapter, owning your success and contributing to shared goals. We actively talk about technology https://tech.loveholidays.com/ and adhere to our key technology principles https://tech.loveholidays.com/the-5-principles-that-helped-scale-loveholidays-7ea0b0fd3df9 that have guided us this far. We are growing and have  ambitious plans to expand across Europe, employing the best minds and technology to let us do this.



The impact you’ll have:

You’ll join our Web Infrastructure team, reporting to the Senior Lead Engineer. The team builds the shared foundations behind loveholidays’ customer experiences, spanning our web and app platforms, design system, edge computing and experimentation.

You’ll help shape these foundations by:

 - Building platforms that enable market-leading web performance and accessibility by default, giving product teams the foundations to deliver fast https://medium.com/loveholidays-tech/the-evolution-of-the-loveholidays-web-platform-9b34f59c8c5a, inclusive customer experiences.

 - Evolving our design system to help engineers, designers and AI agents deliver consistent, high-quality experiences.

 - Improving developer experience and reliability through faster builds https://tech.loveholidays.com/build-baby-build-276e445f539e, actionable error reporting https://tech.loveholidays.com/stop-chasing-ghost-errors-a-systematic-approach-to-frontend-error-monitoring-that-actually-works-fe5e1c8790cc and tools that make systems easier to develop and operate.

 - Owning problems from discovery through delivery by working directly with internal customers to identify priorities and validate that solutions meet their needs.



Your skillset:

 - Strong frontend engineering and performance skills – you have deep experience with a modern frontend framework (we use Preact), TypeScript and CSS, and can diagnose performance bottlenecks and measure how architectural and implementation changes affect Core Web Vitals and real-world performance.

 - Experience building shared frontend foundations – you’ve built and maintained robust and reusable design systems and developer tooling – managing governance, compatibility and providing clear documentation and migration paths for adopting teams.

 - Accessibility engineering – you have experience embedding automated accessibility checks into component tests and CI, preventing regressions, and complementing automation with keyboard and assistive technology testing.

 - Infrastructure ownership – you have experience operating production infrastructure through infrastructure as code tools, such as Terraform, with attention to safe changes, observability and reliability.

 - Building systems for AI agents – you understand how clear interfaces, reusable capabilities, machine-readable context and automated validation help agents work reliably within defined constraints.

 - Product engineering mindset – you’re comfortable with ambiguous problems, can challenge proposed solutions and weigh trade-offs, and use research, adoption metrics and performance data to guide decisions.



The interview journey:

 1. TA screening - 30 mins

 2. 1st stage interview with the Hiring Manager - 45 mins

 3. Tech challenge - you can choose between a live and take home option

 4. Final stage - consisting of discussions around three key areas



Perks of joining us:

 - Company pension contributions at 5%.

 - Individualised training budget for you to learn on the job and level yourself up.

 - Cycle to work scheme, season ticket loan and eye care vouchers.

postings.title: Senior Social Media Executive
postings.description:
Why loveholidays?
At loveholidays - we trailblaze together. We’re on a mission to open the world to everyone, giving our customers’ unlimited choice, unmatched ease and unmissable value for their next getaway. Our team is the driving force behind our role as our customers’ personal holiday expert - the smart way to get away.


We’re using progressive tech to drive cutting-edge innovation and open the world to everyone. Within our Commercial and Support teams, you'll find a place to accelerate your growth by actively seeking learning opportunities and carving your own path. You'll create impact for our future by owning projects and shaping the business strategy to reach shared goals, all within our enhanced international community of collaborative and passionate teams.


About the team:

You’ll be joining our Brand Marketing team, bringing together Brand, Social, PR and Content to build awareness, strengthen trust and make loveholidays the easiest and most valuable way for customers to book their next holiday across our markets.


We put customers at the heart of everything we do, using insight, creativity and culture to create relevant work throughout the journey, from inspiring people to dream about their next getaway to helping them book and travel with confidence. We’re a curious, collaborative team who love understanding what makes our customers tick and turning those insights into work that earns attention, adds value and supports our mission to open the world to everyone.




The impact you’ll have:

Reporting to the Senior Social Media Manager, this is an exciting opportunity to join our brand team at loveholidays, providing hands-on tactical and strategic support to build the loveholidays brand across social media channels.


As Senior Social Media Executive, you will be instrumental in driving loveholidays’ brand engagement and visibility across various social media platforms. You will oversee the execution of our social media strategy, delivering our brand message across all live platforms with socially native, thumb stopping content. Your responsibilities will include end-to-end management and creation of social media content, managing social media platforms and communities, social listening and leveraging analytics to measure and optimise our channels for growth and content performance.


We are looking for a creative, with strong attention to detail, a passion for social media and building brand communities online, who can hit the ground running creating content for and managing our current content calendars.



Your day-to-day:

 - Execute loveholidays’ social media strategy across all live platforms, bringing the brand to life through engaging, on-brand content that inspires travel and drives long-term community growth.
   

 - Own and maintain the social media and marketing calendars, ensuring a consistent and timely flow of content aligned with company news, campaigns, product updates, seasonal moments and key marketing messages.
   

 - Stay informed on social media trends, platform updates, emerging channels and audience behaviours, identifying opportunities to keep loveholidays’ content relevant, timely and culturally connected.
   

 - Support the Senior Social Media Manager and wider content team in developing creative, community-led ideas, turning web content, customer insight and brand priorities into engaging social concepts and copy.
   

 - Create high-quality, multi-format social content across video, photography, graphics, animation, written posts and interactive formats, ensuring every piece is adapted appropriately for each platform and audience.
   

 - Own the execution of video-first social media content, from concept development and scripting through to filming, presenting, editing and publishing, while feeling comfortable both on and off camera.
   

 - Use strong design skills to produce polished, platform-native creative, applying loveholidays’ visual identity and brand guidelines consistently across social assets, campaigns and content series.
   

 - Develop, test and scale repeatable content formats; manage user-generated content and influencer activity; monitor and engage with the community daily; and analyse performance data to refine strategy and report results to stakeholders.
   



Your skillset:

 - Strong understanding of social media best practices, platform behaviours and emerging trends

 - Excellent visual judgement, with the ability to create thumb-stopping static and video content

 - Hands-on content creation skills, including filming, starring-in, editing, curating and adapting content for different platforms

 - Proven experience creating highly engaging content across Instagram, TikTok, Facebook and other relevant social channels

 - Ability to analyse social media performance data, identify actionable insights and make practical content and channel recommendations

 - Experience using social media management, reporting and listening tools, including Sprout Social, Canva, CapCut and social listening queries
   



Desirable:

 - Experience working across multiple markets including UK, IE, DE and SE

 - Experience bringing brand and marketing campaigns to life through social media

 - Confident using AI tools responsibly to streamline social media workflows, including ideation, planning, reporting, content repurposing and social listening, while maintaining strong editorial judgement and brand standards

 - Additional language capability in German, Swedish or Polish
   



The interview journey:

 1. Intro meet with a member of the Talent Acquisition team - 30 mins

 2. 1st stage with the Senior Social Media Manager - 45 mins

 3. Final In-office interview to present a social task with Social Media Manager & a Senior stakeholder - 1 hr
    



Perks of joining us:

postings.title: Data Scientist
postings.description:
Why loveholidays?

We’re on a mission to open the world to everyone, giving our customers unlimited choice, unmatched ease and unmissable value for their next getaway.

Our trailblaze together culture is what drives our success, powered by our people and the way they work. Using progressive technology, we drive cutting-edge innovation and improve how our customers discover, book and experience their holidays. You’ll have the opportunity to accelerate your growth through meaningful challenges, new experiences and the freedom to shape your own path. You’ll create impact for our future by taking ownership, contributing to shared goals and helping shape what comes next, all as part of our enhanced international community of talented, collaborative and passionate teams.



The difference you’ll make

You’ll sit in the Data Science team, reporting to the Head of Data Science. You’ll work closely with Product and Engineering teams to develop predictive models for pricing, recommendations, and other business domains. Together, the team will leverage data to build statistical models that improve commercial decisions.

Data Science sits within our Platform function, which builds the technology and shared capabilities that power the loveholidays experience. By creating scalable products, systems and tools, Platform helps the wider organisation move faster, work more independently and deliver better outcomes for customers.

Your day-to-day:

 - Build and improve data science products across pricing, recommendations and other business domains to improve customer experiences and commercial outcomes.

 - Turn ambiguous business problems into practical data science solutions, from exploration and modelling through to experimentation and evaluation.

 - Partner with engineers, analysts and product teams to deploy reliable models and embed recommendations into everyday decision-making.

 - Monitor model performance, investigate changes and continuously improve solutions as customer behaviour and business needs evolve.

 - Communicate findings clearly, challenge assumptions and help teams make confident, evidence-based decisions.



Your skillset:

 - Strong experience developing and delivering practical machine learning solutions, balancing model performance, business value and long-term maintainability.

 - Proficiency in Python and SQL, with experience working with large, complex datasets.

 - A solid grounding in statistics, experimentation and machine learning, including model evaluation and causal thinking.

 - Experience collaborating with engineers to deploy, monitor and improve models in production.

 - Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts and influence product and commercial decisions.

postings.title: Senior Product Manager - Direct Hotels
postings.description:
Why loveholidays?

We’re on a mission to open the world to everyone, giving our customers unlimited choice, unmatched ease and unmissable value for their next getaway.

Our trailblaze together culture is what drives our success, powered by our people and the way they work. Using progressive technology, we drive cutting-edge innovation and improve how our customers discover, book and experience their holidays. You’ll have the opportunity to accelerate your growth through meaningful challenges, new experiences and the freedom to shape your own path. You’ll create impact for our future by taking ownership, contributing to shared goals and helping shape what comes next, all as part of our enhanced international community of talented, collaborative and passionate teams.



The difference you’ll make

You’ll own the products that help loveholidays grow direct relationships with hotels. By making it easier for partners to join us, manage their supply and improve their performance, you’ll help hotels achieve their commercial goals while giving our customers greater choice and value.

Our ambition is to build an industry-leading operating system for our suppliers: bringing together onboarding, day-to-day management and the insights partners need to make better commercial decisions. You’ll help turn that ambition into a clear product direction. Your initial focus will be simplifying hotel onboarding and improving how effectively we turn direct hotel supply into bookings.

You’ll be part of the Direct Hotels team, reporting to the Head of Product for Supply Platform. Working closely with Engineering, Design, Commercial, Operations and Analytics to build capabilities for hotel partners that support our broader supply strategy. The team sits within Platform, which provides shared technology and tools to help teams across loveholidays deliver the outcomes that drive value for our suppliers and experiences that delight our customers.

Your day-to-day:

 - Own the product direction and roadmap. Translate the Direct Hotels ambition into prioritised opportunities, clear outcomes and achievable delivery increments. Make informed trade-offs between supplier needs, commercial value and technical investment.

 - Understand the people using our products. Work directly with hotel partners, contracting teams and loading operations to uncover problems, test ideas and understand what will drive adoption.

 - Improve the journey from onboarding to bookable supply. Simplify how information is collected, checked and maintained, using automation and self-service where they make the experience easier to navigate and more reliable.

 - Build towards supplier self-service. Develop capabilities that progressively give hotels more control over their relationship with us, working towards connected management tools and useful commercial insights.

 - Take products from discovery through to measurable impact. Work closely with Engineering and Design to prototype, test, deliver and iterate. Explore practical applications of AI, define success measures and use evidence from adoption, supplier feedback and commercial performance to guide what comes next.



Your skillset:

 - Product ownership and strategic delivery: A track record of taking complex problems from discovery through to delivery and demonstrating meaningful user and business outcomes. The ability to connect a long-term vision to the next useful improvement, navigate uncertainty and drive delivery.

 - Supplier and user understanding: The ability to understand different users’ goals and turn complicated workflows into useful, intuitive products. Experience with B2B, supplier, partner or marketplace products would be particularly valuable.

 - Commercial and analytical judgement: Confidence connecting product decisions to growth, margin and operating costs, while considering value for both hotel partners and holidaymakers. Experience defining success measures, investigating performance and using data alongside qualitative research to make decisions.

 - Communication and technical fluency: Clear communication and the ability to align commercial, operational and technical colleagues around priorities, decisions and outcomes. Comfortable discussing APIs, integrations, data and platform constraints with Engineering.

 - Experimentation and AI curiosity: A practical approach to testing ideas and applying new capabilities, including examples of how you have used or evaluated AI to improve products or ways of working.

Experience in hotel distribution or travel technology would be welcome, but is not essential. We’re also interested in people who have solved comparable supplier, marketplace or operational challenges in other industries.



The interview journey:

 - Talent intro, 30 minutes

 - First stage with the hiring manager, 45 minutes

 - Final stage with key stakeholders, including a platform case to present, 1 hour

 - Behavioural and culture conversation with the VP of Product, 45 minutes



Perks of joining us:

 - Company pension contributions at 5%

postings.description:
Why loveholidays?

We’re on a mission to open the world to everyone, giving our customers unlimited choice, unmatched ease and unmissable value for their next getaway.

Our trailblaze together culture is what drives our success, powered by our people and the way they work. The difference you’ll make

You’ll sit in the Product Marketing team, reporting to the Head of Product Marketing. You’ll work closely with our international commercial teams alongside Product, Design, Research, and Engineering to champion our international customers, identify what drives their booking choices, and uncover where loveholidays can win. Together, the team will turn customer empathy and market intelligence into high-impact proposition improvements and rapid experimentation that accelerate growth across key international markets, starting with a strong focus on Germany and the Netherlands.

The Product Marketing team acts as the critical bridge between local market dynamics and core platform execution. Collectively, the team combines qualitative customer research with deep commercial analytics to evaluate competitor models, diagnose performance gaps across the end-to-end booking journey, and define high-value opportunities that scale effectively across borders.

Product Marketing sits within our Platform function, which builds the technology and shared capabilities that power the loveholidays experience. By creating scalable products, systems and tools, Platform helps the wider organisation move faster, work more independently and deliver better outcomes for customers.

Your day-to-day:


INTERNATIONAL CUSTOMER AND COMPETITOR EXPERTISE

 - Build a deep understanding of customers in each international market: their needs, motivations, booking habits, expectations and barriers to choosing loveholidays. With a specific focus on Germany and the Netherlands.

 - Get hands-on with customer research, feedback and the end-to-end holiday journey, building real empathy and bringing the international customer’s voice into decisions across the business.

 - Understand competitor propositions and business models in detail. Experience their products, assess how well they meet local customer needs and identify where we need to close gaps or offer something more compelling.

 - Share customer and competitor insight broadly, helping teams distinguish between needs shared across markets and differences that require a local approach.


MARKET PERFORMANCE AND OPPORTUNITIES

 - Understand performance by market, customer segment and stage of the journey, working with commercial and analytics teams to connect customer behaviour with conversion, repeat booking, customer satisfaction and commercial outcomes.

 - Identify where our proposition and experience are strong or weak, combining performance data with customer and competitor evidence to understand why.

 - Prioritise opportunities with clear recommendations on the customer problem, expected impact and how we will measure success.


HANDS-ON EXPERIMENTATION AND IMPROVEMENT

 - Propose and run tests with international commercial and platform teams, taking opportunities from an initial hypothesis through to execution, measurement and a decision on what happens next.

 - Test changes to our proposition, messaging and customer experience, from how we explain our value to how customers search, book and manage their holiday.

 - Use results to refine our approach, stop ideas that do not work and build evidence for wider investment in those that do.


A PLATFORM THAT SCALES INTERNATIONALLY

 - Translate international customer needs and market opportunities into clear proposition and experience requirements for product, design and engineering teams.

 - Work with platform teams to influence priorities and shape solutions that address local needs while building capabilities we can reuse across markets.

 - Identify where our platform limits international growth, including gaps in localisation, content, payment options, trust and the post-booking experience, and work with teams to test and address them.

 - Bring evidence from current markets into future market planning, helping teams understand what can scale, what needs to adapt and what we should validate before launch.



Your skillset:

 - You have significant experience in product marketing, proposition development, growth or a closely related discipline within a consumer-facing digital business, including work across international markets.

 - You are a customer expert. You go beyond research decks, spend time understanding real behaviour and can explain how needs differ between markets and customer segments.

 - You understand competition at the proposition level: why customers choose one provider over another, how different businesses deliver value and what that means for our own choices.

 - You are confident working with data. You can interpret market and customer performance, ask the right questions and combine quantitative and qualitative evidence into a clear point of view.

 - You have a track record of hands-on experimentation. You can turn an opportunity into a testable hypothesis, work with others to deliver it and use the results to decide what to do next.

 - You know how to work with product, design and engineering teams, translating customer needs into clear problems and requirements and balancing local relevance with platform scalability.

 - You communicate clearly and lead through influence. You build momentum across commercial and platform teams and challenge assumptions constructively.

 - You are comfortable moving between setting direction and doing the work. You bring curiosity, sound judgement and personal ownership of results.

postings.title: Flight Ticketing and Disruption Manager
postings.description:
Why loveholidays? 
We’re on a mission to open the world to everyone, giving our customers unlimited choice, unmatched ease and unmissable value for their next getaway.

Our trailblaze together culture is what drives our success, powered by our people and the way they work. Using progressive technology, we drive cutting-edge innovation and improve how our customers discover, book and experience their holidays. You’ll have the opportunity to accelerate your growth through meaningful challenges, new experiences and the freedom to shape your own path. You’ll create impact for our future by taking ownership, contributing to shared goals and helping shape what comes next, all as part of our enhanced international community of talented, collaborative and passionate teams.



The difference you’ll make

You'll sit in the Aviation team, reporting to the Senior Operations Manager. You'll work closely with Commercial, Supply Tech, Product and Finance to own ticketing and disruption performance across our 140+ airline partners, making sure every flight we sell is ticketed correctly and every schedule change is handled quickly, accurately and fairly. Together, the team uses airline know-how, data and automation to protect revenue, reduce manual effort and give customers a consistent experience whenever their travel plans change, in every market we sell in.



Aviation sits within our Enablement function, where everything we do starts with the customer. From the moment someone books to the day they arrive home, Customer Experience teams make sure they feel looked after, especially when things don't go to plan. By turning what we learn from every booking, contact and disruption into better processes, clearer communication and smarter tools, the Customer function helps build the trust that brings customers back to loveholidays time and again.



Your day-to-day:

 - Own ticketing and amendment quality including both managed and self-managed airline relationships, keeping queues clear and disruption handled consistently

 - Own the day-to-day operational performance of the team, maintaining strong operational grip across queue health, ticketing turnaround, SLA adherence and quality. Use data and insight to identify recurring issues, drive continuous improvement and translate findings into clear, actionable recommendations that improve performance and customer outcomes

 - Act as the team's subject matter expert for Amadeus Robotics, driving adoption of automation and robotic tools across the team.

 - Share best practice from the core market across all points of sale, keeping process documentation current and consistently applied.

 - Play a central role in getting Flight Ticketing & Disruption ready for new market launches, from process setup to team readiness.

 - Lead, coach and motivate a team of ticketing agents, supporting escalations and day-to-day people leadership.


Your skillset:

 - Experience working across both scheduled and low cost carriers

 - Strong and recent Amadeus GDS experience a must

 - Experience of flight pooling, including the coordination, allocation and optimisation of flight inventory across multiple channels, markets or customer bookings.

 - Experience in managing the operational complexity this creates, ensuring accurate ticketing, timely action on schedule changes, effective queue management and strong control of service levels, quality and commercial outcomes

 - Experience with Amadeus Robotics or other automation tools

 - Knowledge of BSP processes, ADM/ACM notices, ticketing rules and IATA regulations a real advantage

 - Comfortable working with data and reporting to identify issues and track performance.

 - Strong communication skills, able to share best practice and coach others effectively



The interview journey:

 - Talent Acquisition Partner screening - 30 mins

 - 1st stage with Hiring Manager + Head of Customer Operations - 45 mins

 - Final stage presenting to Hiring Manager + CX Director, in office - 1 hour



Perks of joining us:

 - Company pension contributions at 5%

 - Individualised training budget for you to learn on the job and level yourself up

 - Discounted holidays for you, your family and friends

 - 25 days of holidays per annum (plus 8 public holidays) increases by 1 day for every second year of service, up to a maximum 30 days per annum

 - Ability to buy and sell annual leave

 - Access to our electric vehicle salary sacrifice scheme 

 - Cycle to work scheme, season ticket loan and eye care vouchers
